title: Global Protests Mark One Year Since Gaza Ceasefire
detail: Pro-Palestinian solidarity protests took place across multiple countries, including the UK, marking one year since the Gaza ceasefire. Demonstrators rallied globally to demand continued attention to conditions in Gaza and lasting peace.

media.caption: Pro-Palestinian protesters rally in the UK marking one year since the Gaza ceasefire

title: Israeli Media Exposes Qatar's $100M Gaza Aid Package Details
detail: Israeli media revealed details of Qatar's $100M Gaza aid package, raising questions about aid conditionality, diversion risks, and Hamas's ability to leverage reconstruction funds. The report surfaces concerns from other ceasefire parties about how the funds could be channeled and whether Hamas might use reconstruction financing as a political instrument.
